title: Unequal Recreational Losses? Revealed Preference Evidence of Campsite Closures in Hawaiʻi
text: This site provides a walk through on the results from Unequal Recreational Losses? Revealed Preference Evidence of Campsite Closures in Hawaiʻi. This tab covers the comparison by loading the data from the models. Tabs MDCEV and RUM are the codes that will run each model.

title: Unequal Recreational Losses? Revealed Preference Evidence of Campsite Closures in Hawaiʻi
text:
Plot

Mean Per Park
So this model takes the park mean of the welfare per person and shows the mean per park across years. The stability shows that will including a frequency trip in RUM shows the highest variation, the RUM opt out is more concise and then the MDCEV is always in the middle.


Show code
# Summarize and Reshape the data
plot_data <- final_comparison_master %>%
  group_by(parkname, year) %>%
  filter(parkname!="Stay_Home")%>%
  summarise(
    RepeatedRUM = mean(annual_rum_loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    MDCEV = mean(loss_mdcev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ObservedRUM, RepeatedRUM, MDCEV),
    names_to = "Model_Type",
    values_to = "Mean_Welfare_Loss"
  )


# Create the Boxplot

Mean Per Person
This run will show you the average per person across the years. It pulls Krinsky-Robb errors


Show code
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)
years <- 2018:2023

##  RUM: Krinsky-Robb, average site closure (losses as positive values) ------------------
rum <- do.call(rbind, lapply(years, function(y) {
  s <- kr_list_52[[paste("52wk", y)]]$summary
  r <- s[s$measure == "Average site closure", ]
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == 1)
  data.frame(model = "Repeated RUM", year = y, est = -r$mean, lo = -r$upper, hi = -r$lower)
}))

## MDCEV: rmdcev parameter draws (mdcev.sim), average over single-site closures
## welfare_list[["YYYY"]]: list of per-person matrices, parameter draws x policies run from models

md <- do.call(rbind, lapply(years, function(y) {
  w <- welfare_list[[as.character(y)]]
  J <- mdcev_model_list[[as.character(y)]]$stan_data$J
  if (ncol(as.matrix(w[[1]])) < J + 1)
    stop(y, ": welfare has fewer than J + 1 policies (check the policy loop for this year)")
  draws <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(w, function(m) as.matrix(m)[, 1:J, drop = FALSE])) / length(w)
  avg   <- -rowMeans(draws)  # each draw: mean per person, averaged over sites
  data.frame(model = "MDCEV", year = y, est = mean(avg),
             lo = unname(quantile(avg, 0.025)), hi = unname(quantile(avg, 0.975)))
}))

d <- rbind(rum, md) 
d$model <- factor(d$model, levels = c("Repeated RUM", "MDCEV"))
print(transform(d, est = round(est, 3), lo = round(lo, 3), hi = round(hi, 3)), row.names = FALSE)

title: Unequal Recreational Losses? Revealed Preference Evidence of Campsite Closures in Hawaiʻi
text:
Elasticity
Figure 3. Total-trip price elasticities by year, repeated RUM and MDCEV, 2018–2023


Show code
library(ggplot2)
years <- 2018:2023
incs  <- c(1, 10, 20, 50)
s_vec <- incs / 100

## ---- Repeated RUM: change in expected trips (52 x site probabilities), Krinsky-Robb CI ----
rum_el <- function(m, seed, R = 1000) {
  X    <- model.matrix(m)[grepl("_w1$", idx(m, 1)), ]       # week 1 only: all 52 weeks are identical
  alts <- unique(as.character(idx(m, 2))); site <- alts != "Stay_Home"
  trips <- function(b, s) {                                  # expected trips with costs x (1 + s)
    Xs <- X; Xs[, "price"] <- (1 + s) * Xs[, "price"]
    E  <- exp(matrix(Xs %*% b[colnames(X)], ncol = length(alts), byrow = TRUE))
    sum((E / rowSums(E))[, site])
  }
  el <- function(b) sapply(s_vec, function(s) (trips(b, s) / trips(b, 0) - 1) / s)
  set.seed(seed)
  kr <- t(apply(MASS::mvrnorm(R, coef(m), vcov(m)), 1, el))
  data.frame(est = el(coef(m)), lo = apply(kr, 2, quantile, .025), hi = apply(kr, 2, quantile, .975))
}

## ---- MDCEV: conditional demand, budget holds (numeraire solved by bisection) --------------
md_el <- function(mod) {
  sd <- mod$stan_data; x <- sd$quant_j; p <- sd$price_j; y <- as.numeric(sd$income)
  k  <- rowSums(x) > 0; x <- x[k, ]; p <- p[k, ]; y <- y[k]  # campers with trips
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x)
  el <- function(g, a1, s) {
    G   <- matrix(g, nrow(x), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
    dem <- function(z) pmax(0, (G + x) / (1 + s) * (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - G) * (x > 0)
    lo <- 0 * y; hi <- y
    for (i in 1:60) {                                        # numeraire z that exhausts income
      z <- (lo + hi) / 2; up <- y - z - (1 + s) * rowSums(p * dem(z)) > 0
      lo[up] <- z[up]; hi[!up] <- z[!up]
    }
    (sum(dem(z)) / sum(x) - 1) / s
  }
  th <- as.matrix(mod$stan_fit$theta_tilde)
  gc <- grep("^gamma", colnames(th)); ac <- grep("^alpha", colnames(th))[1]
  E  <- t(apply(th, 1, function(r) sapply(s_vec, function(s) el(r[gc], r[ac], s))))
  data.frame(est = colMeans(E), lo = apply(E, 2, quantile, .025), hi = apply(E, 2, quantile, .975))
}

rum <- do.call(rbind, lapply(years, function(y)
  data.frame(model = "Repeated RUM", year = y, inc = incs,
             rum_el(model_list_52[[paste("52wk", y)]], seed = 898989 + y))))
md  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(years, function(y)
  data.frame(model = "MDCEV", year = y, inc = incs,
             md_el(mdcev_model_list[[as.character(y)]]))))

title: Models
text:
This script will run a RUM model on our data assuming a stay at home option and compare it to our result of the MDCEV.

Library
Need to run the same data for the MDCEV which gives us final_data_2018. So going to clip the code from the file R script high cost.
The first code will produce final_data_yyyy by year and then should be able to run all the rest of the data

# Load datasets
reservation_data <- read_dta("data/reservation_data_merged_id_complete.dta")
intra_island_distance <- read.csv("data/intra_island_distance2.csv")

# Add year
reservation_data$year <- as.numeric(format(as.Date(reservation_data$CheckinDate, "%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y"))

reservation_data <- reservation_data %>%
  mutate(zip = ifelse(zip == 96812, 96813, zip))

# Function to process data for a single year
process_year <- function(year_input) {
  data_year <- reservation_data %>% filter(year == year_input)
  
  unique_visits <- data_year %>%
    filter(!is.na(CheckinDate)) %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    group_by(id, parkname) %>%
    summarize(VisitCount = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  all_combinations <- expand.grid(
    id = unique(data_year$id),
    parkname = unique(data_year$parkname),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  visit_data <- all_combinations %>%
    left_join(unique_visits, by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(VisitCount = ifelse(is.na(VisitCount), 0, VisitCount))
  
  person_info <- data_year %>%
    select(id, Permittee, zip, Zip, NoOfGuests, days_visited, year) %>%
    distinct()
  
  long_resdata_count <- left_join(visit_data, person_info, by = "id")
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    mutate(island_park = case_when(
      parkname == "Ainapo Cabin" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Hipalau" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kaluahaulu" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kamananui Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kaunala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kawaikoi" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Keanakolu Ranger & Bunkhouse Cabins" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Kuaokala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kulanaahane Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kuliouou Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Lonomea" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Maakua Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Manana Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Peacock Flats Campsite" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Sugi Grove" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waialae Cabin Campsite" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikoali" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikolu" ~ "Molokai",
      parkname == "Waimano Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Waimanu Campsite" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Wiliwili" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Wiliwilinui Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count[order(long_resdata_count$id, long_resdata_count$parkname), ]
  long_resdata_count$parkname_numeric <- as.integer(factor(long_resdata_count$parkname, levels = unique(long_resdata_count$parkname)))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  final_data <- long_resdata_count %>%
    left_join(
      intra_island_distance %>%
        select(zip, parkname, income, residents_distance_meters, residents_duration, island_live),
      by = c("zip", "parkname")
    )
  
  final_data <- final_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(visited_another_island = ifelse(any(island_park != island_live & VisitCount > 0), 1, 0)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  final_data$travel_distance_km <- (final_data$residents_distance_meters / 1000) * 2
  
  
  return(final_data)
}

# are built. ----

  summarise(total_visits = sum(VisitCount))
 
data_mdcev <- mdcev.data(final_data_2018,
                         id.var = "id",

##Estimate model

scale_gamma <- function(mle_obj, multiplier) {
  n_psi   <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_psi
  n_gamma <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_gamma
  gamma_cols <- (n_psi + 1):(n_psi + n_gamma)

  orig_gamma <- as.numeric(mle_obj$stan_fit$par$gamma)
  new_gamma  <- orig_gamma * multiplier

  out <- mle_obj
  out$stan_fit$par$gamma[1, ] <- new_gamma
  out$stan_fit$theta_tilde[, gamma_cols] <-
    matrix(new_gamma, nrow = nrow(out$stan_fit$theta_tilde),
           ncol = length(new_gamma), byrow = TRUE)
  out
}

Per person 52-weeks
This section assumes that there are 52 decisions for an indivudal and that they choose to camp or not. We assume the times visit is a choice.

years <- 2018:2023
N_KR  <- 1000                                    # Krinsky-Robb draws
 
model_list_52    <- list()
mcfadden_list_52 <- list()
kr_list_52       <- list()                    # Krinsky-Robb draws per year
week_diag_52    <- list()                    
 
## give each trip a week, at most one trip per week. pref = preferred (calendar) week, whose week is taken goes to the nearest free week (the earlier one on a tie). Undated trips go to the first free week.

assign_weeks <- function(pref) {
  n <- length(pref)
  if (n > 52) stop("a camper has more than 52 trips; cannot place one trip per week")
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, n); used <- logical(52)
  for (k in order(is.na(pref), pref)) {
    w <- if (is.na(pref[k])) 1L else as.integer(pref[k])
    if (used[w]) { free <- which(!used); w <- free[which.min(abs(free - w))] }
    out[k] <- w; used[w] <- TRUE
  }
  out
}
 
# --- Main Loop ---
final_comparison_52_person <- map_df(years, function(yr) {
 
  message(paste(">>> Processing Year (52-week, Stay_Home reference):", yr))
  current_data <- get(paste0("final_data_", yr))
 
  unique_users <- current_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(zip = first(zip), income = first(income), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id))
 
  all_parks <- unique(current_data$parkname)

  dated <- reservation_data %>%
    filter(year == yr, !is.na(CheckinDate)) %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    mutate(week = pmin(as.integer(format(as.Date(CheckinDate), "%U")) + 1, 52)) %>%
    arrange(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    group_by(id, parkname) %>% mutate(k = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
 
  trips <- current_data %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    filter(VisitCount > 0) %>%
    select(id, parkname, VisitCount) %>%
    uncount(VisitCount, .id = "k") %>%
    left_join(dated %>% select(id, parkname, k, pref_week = week),
              by = c("id", "parkname", "k")) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(week = assign_weeks(pref_week)) %>%
    ungroup()
 
  ## checks: one trip per camper-week, and trips per camper-park equal VisitCount
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(trips[, c("id", "week")]))
  chk <- trips %>% count(id, parkname, name = "n_trips") %>%
    full_join(current_data %>% mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>% filter(VisitCount > 0) %>%
                select(id, parkname, VisitCount), by = c("id", "parkname"))
  stopifnot(all(chk$n_trips == chk$VisitCount))
 
  week_diag_52[[as.character(yr)]] <<- data.frame(
    year              = yr,
    trips             = nrow(trips),
    on_calendar_week  = sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week) & trips$week == trips$pref_week),
    moved             = sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week) & trips$week != trips$pref_week),
    no_reservation    = sum(is.na(trips$pref_week)),
    unused_reservations = nrow(dated) - sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week))
  )
  print(week_diag_52[[as.character(yr)]], row.names = FALSE)
 
  df_52_weeks <- unique_users %>%
    expand_grid(week = 1:52) %>%
    mutate(choice_id = paste0(id, "_w", week))
 
  weekly_panel <- df_52_weeks %>%
    left_join(trips %>% select(id, week, chosen_park = parkname), by = c("id", "week")) %>%
    mutate(chosen_park = replace_na(chosen_park, "Stay_Home"))
  stopifnot(nrow(weekly_panel) == nrow(df_52_weeks))
 
  assign(paste0("final_data_", yr, "_rum"), weekly_panel, envir = .GlobalEnv)
 
  # --- Build the full choice set (one row per person-week-alternative) ---
  df_rum_final <- weekly_panel %>%
    expand_grid(parkname = c(all_parks, "Stay_Home")) %>%
    mutate(choice = (chosen_park == parkname)) %>%
    left_join(current_data %>% mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>% select(id, parkname, price),
              by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(price = ifelse(parkname == "Stay_Home", 0, price))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(df_rum_final$price))
 
  df_idx_local <- dfidx(df_rum_final, idx = list("choice_id", "parkname"), shape = "long")
 
  ##  Stay_Home is the reference alternative (its constant is fixed at 0)
  rum_mle_52 <- tryCatch({
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "nr")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("NR Solver failed, trying BHHH...")
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "bhhh")
  })
 
  model_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- rum_mle_52
 
  rum_null <- mlogit(choice ~ 1 | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home")
  ll_mod  <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_mle_52))
  ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_null))
  mcf_r2  <- 1 - (ll_mod / ll_null)
  mcfadden_list_52[[paste("52weeks", yr)]] <<- format(round(mcf_r2, 3), nsmall = 3)
 
  # --- CHANGED: welfare from one occasion per camper ----------------------
  X   <- model.matrix(rum_mle_52)
  oid <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 1)); alt <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 2))
  alts <- unique(alt); K <- length(alts)
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == length(oid), all(alt == rep(alts, length(unique(oid)))))
  first <- grepl("_w1$", oid) # week 1 of every camper
  X1    <- X[first, , drop = FALSE]
  pid   <- sub("_w1$", "", oid[first][seq(1, sum(first), by = K)])
  sites <- sort(all_parks)
  site_cols <- match(sites, alts); home_col <- match("Stay_Home", alts)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(site_cols), !is.na(home_col))
 
  ## annual losses per camper (campers x policies) for coefficient vector b
  person_loss <- function(b) {
    V  <- matrix(X1 %*% b[colnames(X1)], ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P  <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P <- P / rowSums(P)
    bp <- -b[["price"]]
    L  <- 52 * log(1 - P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]) / bp        # close one site
    colnames(L) <- sites
    cbind(L, "All sites closed" = 52 * log(P[, home_col]) / bp)  # only Stay_Home left
  }
  ## means per camper
  welf_summary <- function(b) {
    L <- person_loss(b); site <- L[, sites, drop = FALSE]
    c(colMeans(site),
      "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
      "All sites closed"          = mean(L[, "All sites closed"]),
      "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site)))
  }
 
  # ---  Krinsky-Robb ----------------------------------------------
  set.seed(898989 + yr)                                      
  draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(N_KR, coef(rum_mle_52), vcov(rum_mle_52))  
  kr <- t(apply(draws, 1, welf_summary))
  pt <- welf_summary(coef(rum_mle_52))
  kr_summary <- data.frame(measure = names(pt), mean = pt,
                           lower = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.025),
                           upper = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.975),
                           row.names = NULL)
  kr_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- list(summary = kr_summary, draws = kr)
  print(kr_summary, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
 
  # --- per-person point estimates (same output as before) -----------------
  Lp <- person_loss(coef(rum_mle_52))
  rum_person_results <- data.frame(
    id              = rep(pid, ncol(Lp)),
    annual_rum_loss = as.vector(Lp),
    parkname        = rep(colnames(Lp), each = nrow(Lp))
  )
 
  year_comparison <- rum_person_results %>%
    left_join(unique_users, by = "id") %>%
    mutate(year = yr)
 
  return(year_comparison)
})

# We compare the current state (All Parks) to the "Closed" state (Stay_Home Only)
total_system_welfare <- df_math %>%
  group_by(trip_id) %>%
  summarise(
    # Inclusive value (Log-Sum) of the current world:
    ls_base = log(sum(exp(V))),
    
    # Inclusive value if ONLY 'Stay_Home' exists (Everything else removed):
    ls_policy = log(sum(exp(V[park_name == "Stay_Home"]))),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Welfare formula: (LS_policy - LS_base) / -beta_price
  mutate(cv_week = (ls_policy - ls_base) / -beta_price) %>%
  
  # Group by User ID to get the Annual Total
  mutate(id = as.character(str_remove(trip_id, "_w\\d+$"))) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(annual_system_loss = sum(cv_week, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

welf_one <- function(pr, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)                                              # MLHS draws for unvisited sites

## ---- 2. Functions -------------------------------------------------------------
# conditional demand after travel costs are multiplied by Fm (N x J matrix of factors),
# with income fixed and the marginal utility of income adjusting. For each camper, the new
# numeraire z solves  y - sum_j Fm_j p_j x_j(z) - z = 0, where
# x_j(z) = g_j [ (1 + x_j/g_j) / Fm_j (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1 ]  for visited sites (0 if negative).
# The left side falls in z, is positive at z = 0 and non-positive at z = y, so the root is
# bracketed and found by bisection; the budget residual is checked.
md_solve <- function(x, p, y, G, a1, Fm, iters = 200, return_z = FALSE) {
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); stopifnot(all(z0 > 0))
  r <- 1 + x / G; vis <- x > 0
  dem <- function(z) ifelse(vis, pmax(0, G * (r / Fm * (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1)), 0)
  excess <- function(z) y - rowSums(Fm * p * dem(z)) - z
  lo <- rep(0, length(y)); hi <- y
  for (it in 1:iters) {
    mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; pos <- excess(mid) > 0
    lo[pos] <- mid[pos]; hi[!pos] <- mid[!pos]
  }
  zs <- (lo + hi) / 2
  if (max(abs(excess(zs))) > 1e-6) stop("md_solve: budget residual too large")
  if (return_z) list(x = dem(zs), z = zs) else dem(zs)
}


# elasticity of total trips when all travel costs rise by s (lambda adjusts)
md_elast <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, s) {
  v <- which(rowSums(x) > 0)
  G <- matrix(g, length(v), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  xn <- md_solve(x[v, , drop = FALSE], p[v, , drop = FALSE], y[v], G, a1,
                 matrix(1 + s, length(v), ncol(x)))
  (sum(xn) / sum(x) - 1) / s
}

# baseline utility (numeraire weight normalised to 1)
md_U0 <- function(x, p, y, G, a1) {
  z <- y - rowSums(p * x)
  psi <- p * (1 + x / G) * z^(a1 - 1)
  list(U0 = rowSums(ifelse(x > 0, psi * G * log1p(x / G), 0)) + z^a1 / a1, psi = psi, z = z)
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing all sites (closed form)
md_welfare_all <- function(x, p, y, g, a1) {
  G <- matrix(g, nrow(x), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  sum((a1 * b$U0)^(1 / a1) - y)
}

# conditional (Hicksian) welfare loss of closing each site one at a time, holding sites not
# visited at baseline at zero trips (this can only raise the loss). For each camper who visited site k: find the numeraire z1 at which utility without
# site k (other visited sites re-optimised) equals baseline utility; the loss is the
# extra spending needed, z1 + sum p_j x_j(z1) - y.
md_welfare_sites <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, iters = 200, detail = FALSE) {
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x)
  G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  W <- numeric(J); det <- vector("list", J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    idx <- which(x[, k] > 0)
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    xs <- x[idx, , drop = FALSE]; ps <- p[idx, , drop = FALSE]; Gs <- G[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    psi <- b$psi[idx, , drop = FALSE]; U0 <- b$U0[idx]
    keep <- (xs > 0); keep[, k] <- FALSE                     # other visited sites
    util <- function(z) {                                     # utility at numeraire z (vector)
      lam <- z^(a1 - 1)
      ratio <- psi / (lam * ps)                               # = 1 + x/G at the optimum
      xj <- ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, Gs * (ratio - 1), 0)
      list(U = rowSums(ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, psi * Gs * log(ratio), 0)) + z^a1 / a1,
           spend = rowSums(ps * xj))
    }
    lo <- b$z[idx]                                            # utility too low here
    hi <- (a1 * U0)^(1 / a1)                                  # numeraire alone reaches U0
    for (it in 1:iters) {
      mid <- (lo + hi) / 2
      u <- util(mid)$U
      lo <- ifelse(u < U0, mid, lo); hi <- ifelse(u < U0, hi, mid)
    }
    z1 <- (lo + hi) / 2
    w_i <- z1 + util(z1)$spend - y[idx]
    W[k] <- sum(w_i)
    if (detail) det[[k]] <- list(idx = idx, z1 = z1, w = w_i)
  }
  if (detail) list(W = W, det = det, U0 = b$U0, R = ifelse(x > 0, b$psi, 0), z0 = b$z) else W
}

# compensating numeraire such that utility at prices P equals U0 (Hicksian), by bisection on
# log t = (1 - a1) log z between lt_lo (utility below U0) and lt_hi (utility above U0).
# Returns z1 and spending on sites at z1.
md_hicks_R <- function(R, P, U0, lt_lo, lt_hi, G, a1, iters = 200) {
  b <- 1 / (1 - a1); RP <- R / P; lRP <- ifelse(RP > 0, log(RP), -Inf)
  util <- function(lt) {
    on <- RP * exp(lt) > 1
    list(U = rowSums(ifelse(on, R * G * (lRP + lt), 0)) + exp(a1 * b * lt) / a1,
         spend = rowSums(ifelse(on, P * G * (RP * exp(lt) - 1), 0)))
  }
  lo <- lt_lo; hi <- lt_hi
  for (it in 1:iters) { mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; low <- util(mid)$U < U0; lo[low] <- mid[low]; hi[!low] <- mid[!low] }
  lt <- (lo + hi) / 2
  list(z1 = exp(b * lt), spend = util(lt)$spend)
}

# Modified Latin hypercube draws (Hess et al., 2006), as in rmdcev: for each of n vectors, D
# uniform draws, one in each interval [(d-1)/D, d/D), in random order. Returns an n x D matrix.
mlhs <- function(n, D) {
  U <- (matrix(rep(0:(D - 1), each = n), n, D) + matrix(runif(n * D), n, D)) / D
  idx <- t(apply(matrix(runif(n * D), n, D), 1, order))
  matrix(U[cbind(rep(1:n, D), as.vector(idx))], n, D)
}

# Conditional error draws, following rmdcev (Lloyd-Smith, 2021): the error of the numeraire is set
# to zero, the errors of visited sites follow from the first-order conditions at the observed trips,
# and the error of each site not visited is drawn from the type I extreme value distribution
# truncated so that the site is not chosen (R_j / p_j <= lambda). This gives
# R_j / (lambda p_j) = (1 + E / w_j)^(-sigma), with E = -log(u), u a modified Latin hypercube draw,
# and w_j = (psi_j / (lambda p_j))^(1/sigma). Sites without trips in the sample are not available.
# (numeraire = "posterior" instead draws the numeraire error from its distribution given the
# observed trips; this was used in an earlier version and is kept for reference.)
# Returns the visited R (N x J) and, for every draw, the unvisited R (N x J x D).
md_cond_draws <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, lpsi, scale, D, numeraire = c("zero", "posterior")) {
  numeraire <- match.arg(numeraire)
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x); G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  vis <- x > 0; avail <- matrix(colSums(x) > 0, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); lam0 <- z0^(a1 - 1)
  R <- ifelse(vis, p * (1 + x / G) * lam0, 0)
  psi <- matrix(exp(lpsi), N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  w <- (psi / (lam0 * p))^(1 / scale)
  unv <- !vis & avail
  K <- rowSums(vis)
  Rd <- array(0, c(N, J, D))
  if (numeraire == "zero") {
    U <- array(mlhs(N * J, D), c(N, J, D))                     # draws for camper i, site j in U[i, j, ]
    for (d in 1:D) Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 - log(U[, , d]) / w)^(-scale), 0)
  } else {
    A <- 1 + rowSums(ifelse(vis, (psi / R)^(1 / scale), 0)) + rowSums(ifelse(unv, w, 0))
    for (d in 1:D) {
      t <- rgamma(N, shape = K + 1, rate = A)
      E <- matrix(rexp(N * J), N, J)
      Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 + E / (t * w))^(-scale), 0)
    }
  }
  Rd[K == 0, , ] <- 0                       # campers without trips never start a trip after a cost rise
  list(R = R, Rd = Rd, G = G, z0 = z0, lam0 = lam0,
       Mx = apply(Rd / array(p, c(N, J, D)), c(1, 3), max))       # N x D: highest R_j/p_j among unvisited
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing each site, allowing unvisited sites to enter (same logic:
# the no-entry solution is kept unless an unvisited site would be chosen at its marginal utility
# of income). Returns the losses ($, all campers), the no-entry losses and the share with entry.
md_welfare_sites_cond <- function(CD, x, p, y, g, a1) {
  J <- ncol(x); D <- dim(CD$Rd)[3]
  ne <- md_welfare_sites(x, p, y, g, a1, detail = TRUE)
  W <- ne$W; share <- rep(NA_real_, J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    d <- ne$det[[k]]; if (is.null(d)) next
    v <- d$idx; wk <- matrix(d$w, length(v), D)
    flag <- CD$Mx[v, , drop = FALSE] > d$z1^(a1 - 1)
    if (any(flag)) {
      fi <- which(flag, arr.ind = TRUE); ii <- v[fi[, 1]]
      Rf <- CD$R[ii, , drop = FALSE] + t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(fi)), function(m) CD$Rd[ii[m], , fi[m, 2]]))
      if (nrow(fi) == 1) Rf <- matrix(Rf, 1)
      Rf[, k] <- 0
      U0 <- ne$U0[ii]
      h <- md_hicks_R(Rf, p[ii, , drop = FALSE], U0, lt_lo = (1 - a1) * log(ne$z0[ii]),
                      lt_hi = (1 - a1) / a1 * log(a1 * U0), CD$G[ii, , drop = FALSE], a1)
      wk[fi] <- h$z1 + h$spend - y[ii]
    }
    W[k] <- sum(wk) / D; share[k] <- mean(flag)
  }
  list(W = W, W_ne = ne$W, share = share)
}

## parameters from one row of draws (or the point estimates): site 1 is the base (psi = 0)
get_pars <- function(th) {
  nm <- names(th)
  list(lpsi  = c(0, th[grepl("^psi\\[", nm)]),
       g     = th[grepl("^gamma\\[", nm)],
       a1    = th[grepl("^alpha\\[", nm)][1],
       scale = th[grepl("^scale\\[", nm)][1])
}

## welfare (per person) and total-trip elasticities for one parameter set
md_measures <- function(pr, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)                                                    # MLHS draws for unvisited sites
  CD <- md_cond_draws(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, pr$lpsi, pr$scale, NERRS)
  W  <- c(md_welfare_sites_cond(CD, x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)$W,
          md_welfare_all(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)) / N
  el <- sapply(s_vec, function(s) md_elast(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, s))
  c(-W, el)                                                         # losses negative, as rmdcev
}

## ---- 2. Functions -------------------------------------------------------------
# conditional demand after travel costs are multiplied by Fm (N x J matrix of factors),
# with income fixed and the marginal utility of income adjusting. For each camper, the new
# numeraire z solves  y - sum_j Fm_j p_j x_j(z) - z = 0, where
# x_j(z) = g_j [ (1 + x_j/g_j) / Fm_j (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1 ]  for visited sites (0 if negative).
# The left side falls in z, is positive at z = 0 and non-positive at z = y, so the root is
# bracketed and found by bisection; the budget residual is checked.
md_solve <- function(x, p, y, G, a1, Fm, iters = 200, return_z = FALSE) {
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); stopifnot(all(z0 > 0))
  r <- 1 + x / G; vis <- x > 0
  dem <- function(z) ifelse(vis, pmax(0, G * (r / Fm * (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1)), 0)
  excess <- function(z) y - rowSums(Fm * p * dem(z)) - z
  lo <- rep(0, length(y)); hi <- y
  for (it in 1:iters) {
    mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; pos <- excess(mid) > 0
    lo[pos] <- mid[pos]; hi[!pos] <- mid[!pos]
  }
  zs <- (lo + hi) / 2
  if (max(abs(excess(zs))) > 1e-6) stop("md_solve: budget residual too large")
  if (return_z) list(x = dem(zs), z = zs) else dem(zs)
}


# elasticity of total trips when all travel costs rise by s (lambda adjusts)
md_elast <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, s) {
  v <- which(rowSums(x) > 0)
  G <- matrix(g, length(v), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  xn <- md_solve(x[v, , drop = FALSE], p[v, , drop = FALSE], y[v], G, a1,
                 matrix(1 + s, length(v), ncol(x)))
  (sum(xn) / sum(x) - 1) / s
}

# baseline utility (numeraire weight normalised to 1)
md_U0 <- function(x, p, y, G, a1) {
  z <- y - rowSums(p * x)
  psi <- p * (1 + x / G) * z^(a1 - 1)
  list(U0 = rowSums(ifelse(x > 0, psi * G * log1p(x / G), 0)) + z^a1 / a1, psi = psi, z = z)
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing all sites (closed form)
md_welfare_all <- function(x, p, y, g, a1) {
  G <- matrix(g, nrow(x), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  sum((a1 * b$U0)^(1 / a1) - y)
}

# conditional (Hicksian) welfare loss of closing each site one at a time, holding sites not
# visited at baseline at zero trips (this can only raise the loss). For each camper who visited site k: find the numeraire z1 at which utility without
# site k (other visited sites re-optimised) equals baseline utility; the loss is the
# extra spending needed, z1 + sum p_j x_j(z1) - y.
md_welfare_sites <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, iters = 200, detail = FALSE) {
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x)
  G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  W <- numeric(J); det <- vector("list", J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    idx <- which(x[, k] > 0)
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    xs <- x[idx, , drop = FALSE]; ps <- p[idx, , drop = FALSE]; Gs <- G[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    psi <- b$psi[idx, , drop = FALSE]; U0 <- b$U0[idx]
    keep <- (xs > 0); keep[, k] <- FALSE                     # other visited sites
    util <- function(z) {                                     # utility at numeraire z (vector)
      lam <- z^(a1 - 1)
      ratio <- psi / (lam * ps)                               # = 1 + x/G at the optimum
      xj <- ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, Gs * (ratio - 1), 0)
      list(U = rowSums(ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, psi * Gs * log(ratio), 0)) + z^a1 / a1,
           spend = rowSums(ps * xj))
    }
    lo <- b$z[idx]                                            # utility too low here
    hi <- (a1 * U0)^(1 / a1)                                  # numeraire alone reaches U0
    for (it in 1:iters) {
      mid <- (lo + hi) / 2
      u <- util(mid)$U
      lo <- ifelse(u < U0, mid, lo); hi <- ifelse(u < U0, hi, mid)
    }
    z1 <- (lo + hi) / 2
    w_i <- z1 + util(z1)$spend - y[idx]
    W[k] <- sum(w_i)
    if (detail) det[[k]] <- list(idx = idx, z1 = z1, w = w_i)
  }
  if (detail) list(W = W, det = det, U0 = b$U0, R = ifelse(x > 0, b$psi, 0), z0 = b$z) else W
}

# compensating numeraire such that utility at prices P equals U0 (Hicksian), by bisection on
# log t = (1 - a1) log z between lt_lo (utility below U0) and lt_hi (utility above U0).
# Returns z1 and spending on sites at z1.
md_hicks_R <- function(R, P, U0, lt_lo, lt_hi, G, a1, iters = 200) {
  b <- 1 / (1 - a1); RP <- R / P; lRP <- ifelse(RP > 0, log(RP), -Inf)
  util <- function(lt) {
    on <- RP * exp(lt) > 1
    list(U = rowSums(ifelse(on, R * G * (lRP + lt), 0)) + exp(a1 * b * lt) / a1,
         spend = rowSums(ifelse(on, P * G * (RP * exp(lt) - 1), 0)))
  }
  lo <- lt_lo; hi <- lt_hi
  for (it in 1:iters) { mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; low <- util(mid)$U < U0; lo[low] <- mid[low]; hi[!low] <- mid[!low] }
  lt <- (lo + hi) / 2
  list(z1 = exp(b * lt), spend = util(lt)$spend)
}

# Modified Latin hypercube draws (Hess et al., 2006), as in rmdcev: for each of n vectors, D
# uniform draws, one in each interval [(d-1)/D, d/D), in random order. Returns an n x D matrix.
mlhs <- function(n, D) {
  U <- (matrix(rep(0:(D - 1), each = n), n, D) + matrix(runif(n * D), n, D)) / D
  idx <- t(apply(matrix(runif(n * D), n, D), 1, order))
  matrix(U[cbind(rep(1:n, D), as.vector(idx))], n, D)
}

# Conditional error draws, following rmdcev (Lloyd-Smith, 2021): the error of the numeraire is set
# to zero, the errors of visited sites follow from the first-order conditions at the observed trips,
# and the error of each site not visited is drawn from the type I extreme value distribution
# truncated so that the site is not chosen (R_j / p_j <= lambda). This gives
# R_j / (lambda p_j) = (1 + E / w_j)^(-sigma), with E = -log(u), u a modified Latin hypercube draw,
# and w_j = (psi_j / (lambda p_j))^(1/sigma). Sites without trips in the sample are not available.
# (numeraire = "posterior" instead draws the numeraire error from its distribution given the
# observed trips; this was used in an earlier version and is kept for reference.)
# Returns the visited R (N x J) and, for every draw, the unvisited R (N x J x D).
md_cond_draws <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, lpsi, scale, D, numeraire = c("zero", "posterior")) {
  numeraire <- match.arg(numeraire)
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x); G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  vis <- x > 0; avail <- matrix(colSums(x) > 0, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); lam0 <- z0^(a1 - 1)
  R <- ifelse(vis, p * (1 + x / G) * lam0, 0)
  psi <- matrix(exp(lpsi), N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  w <- (psi / (lam0 * p))^(1 / scale)
  unv <- !vis & avail
  K <- rowSums(vis)
  Rd <- array(0, c(N, J, D))
  if (numeraire == "zero") {
    U <- array(mlhs(N * J, D), c(N, J, D))                     # draws for camper i, site j in U[i, j, ]
    for (d in 1:D) Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 - log(U[, , d]) / w)^(-scale), 0)
  } else {
    A <- 1 + rowSums(ifelse(vis, (psi / R)^(1 / scale), 0)) + rowSums(ifelse(unv, w, 0))
    for (d in 1:D) {
      t <- rgamma(N, shape = K + 1, rate = A)
      E <- matrix(rexp(N * J), N, J)
      Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 + E / (t * w))^(-scale), 0)
    }
  }
  Rd[K == 0, , ] <- 0                       # campers without trips never start a trip after a cost rise
  list(R = R, Rd = Rd, G = G, z0 = z0, lam0 = lam0,
       Mx = apply(Rd / array(p, c(N, J, D)), c(1, 3), max))       # N x D: highest R_j/p_j among unvisited
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing each site, allowing unvisited sites to enter (same logic:
# the no-entry solution is kept unless an unvisited site would be chosen at its marginal utility
# of income). Returns the losses ($, all campers), the no-entry losses and the share with entry.
md_welfare_sites_cond <- function(CD, x, p, y, g, a1) {
  J <- ncol(x); D <- dim(CD$Rd)[3]
  ne <- md_welfare_sites(x, p, y, g, a1, detail = TRUE)
  W <- ne$W; share <- rep(NA_real_, J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    d <- ne$det[[k]]; if (is.null(d)) next
    v <- d$idx; wk <- matrix(d$w, length(v), D)
    flag <- CD$Mx[v, , drop = FALSE] > d$z1^(a1 - 1)
    if (any(flag)) {
      fi <- which(flag, arr.ind = TRUE); ii <- v[fi[, 1]]
      Rf <- CD$R[ii, , drop = FALSE] + t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(fi)), function(m) CD$Rd[ii[m], , fi[m, 2]]))
      if (nrow(fi) == 1) Rf <- matrix(Rf, 1)
      Rf[, k] <- 0
      U0 <- ne$U0[ii]
      h <- md_hicks_R(Rf, p[ii, , drop = FALSE], U0, lt_lo = (1 - a1) * log(ne$z0[ii]),
                      lt_hi = (1 - a1) / a1 * log(a1 * U0), CD$G[ii, , drop = FALSE], a1)
      wk[fi] <- h$z1 + h$spend - y[ii]
    }
    W[k] <- sum(wk) / D; share[k] <- mean(flag)
  }
  list(W = W, W_ne = ne$W, share = share)
}

## parameters from one row of draws (or the point estimates): site 1 is the base (psi = 0)
get_pars <- function(th) {
  nm <- names(th)
  list(lpsi  = c(0, th[grepl("^psi\\[", nm)]),

       scale = th[grepl("^scale\\[", nm)][1])
}

## welfare (per person) and total-trip elasticities for one parameter set
md_measures <- function(pr, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)                                                    # MLHS draws for unvisited sites
  CD <- md_cond_draws(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, pr$lpsi, pr$scale, NERRS)
  W  <- c(md_welfare_sites_cond(CD, x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)$W,

  el <- sapply(s_vec, function(s) md_elast(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, s))
  c(-W, el)                                                         # losses negative, as rmdcev
}

## Fast MDCEV welfare and total-trip elasticities, 2021 (gamma profile)
## Same model and the same 100 parameter draws as the rmdcev code, but welfare
## and elasticities are computed directly instead of with mdcev.sim:
##  - conditional errors as in rmdcev (numeraire error zero, visited sites from the
##    first-order conditions, unvisited sites from truncated draws, 100 MLHS draws)
##  - welfare: compensating variation of closing each site one at a time and
##    closing all sites (losses per person, negative as in rmdcev's summary)
##  - total-trip elasticity: all travel costs +1, 10, 20, 50 percent, with the

## ---- 2. Functions -------------------------------------------------------------
# conditional demand after travel costs are multiplied by Fm (N x J matrix of factors),
# with income fixed and the marginal utility of income adjusting. For each camper, the new
# numeraire z solves  y - sum_j Fm_j p_j x_j(z) - z = 0, where
# x_j(z) = g_j [ (1 + x_j/g_j) / Fm_j (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1 ]  for visited sites (0 if negative).
# The left side falls in z, is positive at z = 0 and non-positive at z = y, so the root is
# bracketed and found by bisection; the budget residual is checked.
md_solve <- function(x, p, y, G, a1, Fm, iters = 200, return_z = FALSE) {
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); stopifnot(all(z0 > 0))
  r <- 1 + x / G; vis <- x > 0
  dem <- function(z) ifelse(vis, pmax(0, G * (r / Fm * (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1)), 0)
  excess <- function(z) y - rowSums(Fm * p * dem(z)) - z
  lo <- rep(0, length(y)); hi <- y
  for (it in 1:iters) {
    mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; pos <- excess(mid) > 0
    lo[pos] <- mid[pos]; hi[!pos] <- mid[!pos]
  }
  zs <- (lo + hi) / 2
  if (max(abs(excess(zs))) > 1e-6) stop("md_solve: budget residual too large")
  if (return_z) list(x = dem(zs), z = zs) else dem(zs)
}


# elasticity of total trips when all travel costs rise by s (lambda adjusts)
md_elast <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, s) {
  v <- which(rowSums(x) > 0)
  G <- matrix(g, length(v), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  xn <- md_solve(x[v, , drop = FALSE], p[v, , drop = FALSE], y[v], G, a1,
                 matrix(1 + s, length(v), ncol(x)))
  (sum(xn) / sum(x) - 1) / s
}

# baseline utility (numeraire weight normalised to 1)
md_U0 <- function(x, p, y, G, a1) {
  z <- y - rowSums(p * x)
  psi <- p * (1 + x / G) * z^(a1 - 1)
  list(U0 = rowSums(ifelse(x > 0, psi * G * log1p(x / G), 0)) + z^a1 / a1, psi = psi, z = z)
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing all sites (closed form)
md_welfare_all <- function(x, p, y, g, a1) {
  G <- matrix(g, nrow(x), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  sum((a1 * b$U0)^(1 / a1) - y)
}

# conditional (Hicksian) welfare loss of closing each site one at a time, holding sites not
# visited at baseline at zero trips (this can only raise the loss). For each camper who visited site k: find the numeraire z1 at which utility without
# site k (other visited sites re-optimised) equals baseline utility; the loss is the
# extra spending needed, z1 + sum p_j x_j(z1) - y.
md_welfare_sites <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, iters = 200, detail = FALSE) {
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x)
  G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  W <- numeric(J); det <- vector("list", J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    idx <- which(x[, k] > 0)
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    xs <- x[idx, , drop = FALSE]; ps <- p[idx, , drop = FALSE]; Gs <- G[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    psi <- b$psi[idx, , drop = FALSE]; U0 <- b$U0[idx]
    keep <- (xs > 0); keep[, k] <- FALSE                     # other visited sites
    util <- function(z) {                                     # utility at numeraire z (vector)
      lam <- z^(a1 - 1)
      ratio <- psi / (lam * ps)                               # = 1 + x/G at the optimum
      xj <- ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, Gs * (ratio - 1), 0)
      list(U = rowSums(ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, psi * Gs * log(ratio), 0)) + z^a1 / a1,
           spend = rowSums(ps * xj))
    }
    lo <- b$z[idx]                                            # utility too low here
    hi <- (a1 * U0)^(1 / a1)                                  # numeraire alone reaches U0
    for (it in 1:iters) {
      mid <- (lo + hi) / 2
      u <- util(mid)$U
      lo <- ifelse(u < U0, mid, lo); hi <- ifelse(u < U0, hi, mid)
    }
    z1 <- (lo + hi) / 2
    w_i <- z1 + util(z1)$spend - y[idx]
    W[k] <- sum(w_i)
    if (detail) det[[k]] <- list(idx = idx, z1 = z1, w = w_i)
  }
  if (detail) list(W = W, det = det, U0 = b$U0, R = ifelse(x > 0, b$psi, 0), z0 = b$z) else W
}

# compensating numeraire such that utility at prices P equals U0 (Hicksian), by bisection on
# log t = (1 - a1) log z between lt_lo (utility below U0) and lt_hi (utility above U0).
# Returns z1 and spending on sites at z1.
md_hicks_R <- function(R, P, U0, lt_lo, lt_hi, G, a1, iters = 200) {
  b <- 1 / (1 - a1); RP <- R / P; lRP <- ifelse(RP > 0, log(RP), -Inf)
  util <- function(lt) {
    on <- RP * exp(lt) > 1
    list(U = rowSums(ifelse(on, R * G * (lRP + lt), 0)) + exp(a1 * b * lt) / a1,
         spend = rowSums(ifelse(on, P * G * (RP * exp(lt) - 1), 0)))
  }
  lo <- lt_lo; hi <- lt_hi
  for (it in 1:iters) { mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; low <- util(mid)$U < U0; lo[low] <- mid[low]; hi[!low] <- mid[!low] }
  lt <- (lo + hi) / 2
  list(z1 = exp(b * lt), spend = util(lt)$spend)
}

# Modified Latin hypercube draws (Hess et al., 2006), as in rmdcev: for each of n vectors, D
# uniform draws, one in each interval [(d-1)/D, d/D), in random order. Returns an n x D matrix.
mlhs <- function(n, D) {
  U <- (matrix(rep(0:(D - 1), each = n), n, D) + matrix(runif(n * D), n, D)) / D
  idx <- t(apply(matrix(runif(n * D), n, D), 1, order))
  matrix(U[cbind(rep(1:n, D), as.vector(idx))], n, D)
}

# Conditional error draws, following rmdcev (Lloyd-Smith, 2021): the error of the numeraire is set
# to zero, the errors of visited sites follow from the first-order conditions at the observed trips,
# and the error of each site not visited is drawn from the type I extreme value distribution
# truncated so that the site is not chosen (R_j / p_j <= lambda). This gives
# R_j / (lambda p_j) = (1 + E / w_j)^(-sigma), with E = -log(u), u a modified Latin hypercube draw,
# and w_j = (psi_j / (lambda p_j))^(1/sigma). Sites without trips in the sample are not available.
# (numeraire = "posterior" instead draws the numeraire error from its distribution given the
# observed trips; this was used in an earlier version and is kept for reference.)
# Returns the visited R (N x J) and, for every draw, the unvisited R (N x J x D).
md_cond_draws <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, lpsi, scale, D, numeraire = c("zero", "posterior")) {
  numeraire <- match.arg(numeraire)
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x); G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  vis <- x > 0; avail <- matrix(colSums(x) > 0, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); lam0 <- z0^(a1 - 1)
  R <- ifelse(vis, p * (1 + x / G) * lam0, 0)
  psi <- matrix(exp(lpsi), N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  w <- (psi / (lam0 * p))^(1 / scale)
  unv <- !vis & avail
  K <- rowSums(vis)
  Rd <- array(0, c(N, J, D))
  if (numeraire == "zero") {
    U <- array(mlhs(N * J, D), c(N, J, D))                     # draws for camper i, site j in U[i, j, ]
    for (d in 1:D) Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 - log(U[, , d]) / w)^(-scale), 0)
  } else {
    A <- 1 + rowSums(ifelse(vis, (psi / R)^(1 / scale), 0)) + rowSums(ifelse(unv, w, 0))
    for (d in 1:D) {
      t <- rgamma(N, shape = K + 1, rate = A)
      E <- matrix(rexp(N * J), N, J)
      Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 + E / (t * w))^(-scale), 0)
    }
  }
  Rd[K == 0, , ] <- 0                       # campers without trips never start a trip after a cost rise
  list(R = R, Rd = Rd, G = G, z0 = z0, lam0 = lam0,
       Mx = apply(Rd / array(p, c(N, J, D)), c(1, 3), max))       # N x D: highest R_j/p_j among unvisited
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing each site, allowing unvisited sites to enter (same logic:
# the no-entry solution is kept unless an unvisited site would be chosen at its marginal utility
# of income). Returns the losses ($, all campers), the no-entry losses and the share with entry.
md_welfare_sites_cond <- function(CD, x, p, y, g, a1) {
  J <- ncol(x); D <- dim(CD$Rd)[3]
  ne <- md_welfare_sites(x, p, y, g, a1, detail = TRUE)
  W <- ne$W; share <- rep(NA_real_, J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    d <- ne$det[[k]]; if (is.null(d)) next
    v <- d$idx; wk <- matrix(d$w, length(v), D)
    flag <- CD$Mx[v, , drop = FALSE] > d$z1^(a1 - 1)
    if (any(flag)) {
      fi <- which(flag, arr.ind = TRUE); ii <- v[fi[, 1]]
      Rf <- CD$R[ii, , drop = FALSE] + t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(fi)), function(m) CD$Rd[ii[m], , fi[m, 2]]))
      if (nrow(fi) == 1) Rf <- matrix(Rf, 1)
      Rf[, k] <- 0
      U0 <- ne$U0[ii]
      h <- md_hicks_R(Rf, p[ii, , drop = FALSE], U0, lt_lo = (1 - a1) * log(ne$z0[ii]),
                      lt_hi = (1 - a1) / a1 * log(a1 * U0), CD$G[ii, , drop = FALSE], a1)
      wk[fi] <- h$z1 + h$spend - y[ii]
    }
    W[k] <- sum(wk) / D; share[k] <- mean(flag)
  }
  list(W = W, W_ne = ne$W, share = share)
}

## parameters from one row of draws (or the point estimates): site 1 is the base (psi = 0)
get_pars <- function(th) {
  nm <- names(th)
  list(lpsi  = c(0, th[grepl("^psi\\[", nm)]),
       g     = th[grepl("^gamma\\[", nm)],
       a1    = th[grepl("^alpha\\[", nm)][1],
       scale = th[grepl("^scale\\[", nm)][1])
}

## welfare (per person) and total-trip elasticities for one parameter set
md_measures <- function(pr, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)                                                    # MLHS draws for unvisited sites
  CD <- md_cond_draws(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, pr$lpsi, pr$scale, NERRS)
  W  <- c(md_welfare_sites_cond(CD, x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)$W,
          md_welfare_all(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)) / N
  el <- sapply(s_vec, function(s) md_elast(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, s))
  c(-W, el)                                                         # losses negative, as rmdcev
}

## ---- 2. Functions -------------------------------------------------------------
# conditional demand after travel costs are multiplied by Fm (N x J matrix of factors),
# with income fixed and the marginal utility of income adjusting. For each camper, the new
# numeraire z solves  y - sum_j Fm_j p_j x_j(z) - z = 0, where
# x_j(z) = g_j [ (1 + x_j/g_j) / Fm_j (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1 ]  for visited sites (0 if negative).
# The left side falls in z, is positive at z = 0 and non-positive at z = y, so the root is
# bracketed and found by bisection; the budget residual is checked.
md_solve <- function(x, p, y, G, a1, Fm, iters = 200, return_z = FALSE) {
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); stopifnot(all(z0 > 0))
  r <- 1 + x / G; vis <- x > 0
  dem <- function(z) ifelse(vis, pmax(0, G * (r / Fm * (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1)), 0)
  excess <- function(z) y - rowSums(Fm * p * dem(z)) - z
  lo <- rep(0, length(y)); hi <- y
  for (it in 1:iters) {
    mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; pos <- excess(mid) > 0
    lo[pos] <- mid[pos]; hi[!pos] <- mid[!pos]
  }
  zs <- (lo + hi) / 2
  if (max(abs(excess(zs))) > 1e-6) stop("md_solve: budget residual too large")
  if (return_z) list(x = dem(zs), z = zs) else dem(zs)
}


# elasticity of total trips when all travel costs rise by s (lambda adjusts)
md_elast <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, s) {
  v <- which(rowSums(x) > 0)
  G <- matrix(g, length(v), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  xn <- md_solve(x[v, , drop = FALSE], p[v, , drop = FALSE], y[v], G, a1,
                 matrix(1 + s, length(v), ncol(x)))
  (sum(xn) / sum(x) - 1) / s
}

# baseline utility (numeraire weight normalised to 1)
md_U0 <- function(x, p, y, G, a1) {
  z <- y - rowSums(p * x)
  psi <- p * (1 + x / G) * z^(a1 - 1)
  list(U0 = rowSums(ifelse(x > 0, psi * G * log1p(x / G), 0)) + z^a1 / a1, psi = psi, z = z)
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing all sites (closed form)
md_welfare_all <- function(x, p, y, g, a1) {
  G <- matrix(g, nrow(x), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  sum((a1 * b$U0)^(1 / a1) - y)
}

# conditional (Hicksian) welfare loss of closing each site one at a time, holding sites not
# visited at baseline at zero trips (this can only raise the loss). For each camper who visited site k: find the numeraire z1 at which utility without
# site k (other visited sites re-optimised) equals baseline utility; the loss is the
# extra spending needed, z1 + sum p_j x_j(z1) - y.
md_welfare_sites <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, iters = 200, detail = FALSE) {
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x)
  G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  W <- numeric(J); det <- vector("list", J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    idx <- which(x[, k] > 0)
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    xs <- x[idx, , drop = FALSE]; ps <- p[idx, , drop = FALSE]; Gs <- G[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    psi <- b$psi[idx, , drop = FALSE]; U0 <- b$U0[idx]
    keep <- (xs > 0); keep[, k] <- FALSE                     # other visited sites
    util <- function(z) {                                     # utility at numeraire z (vector)
      lam <- z^(a1 - 1)
      ratio <- psi / (lam * ps)                               # = 1 + x/G at the optimum
      xj <- ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, Gs * (ratio - 1), 0)
      list(U = rowSums(ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, psi * Gs * log(ratio), 0)) + z^a1 / a1,
           spend = rowSums(ps * xj))
    }
    lo <- b$z[idx]                                            # utility too low here
    hi <- (a1 * U0)^(1 / a1)                                  # numeraire alone reaches U0
    for (it in 1:iters) {
      mid <- (lo + hi) / 2
      u <- util(mid)$U
      lo <- ifelse(u < U0, mid, lo); hi <- ifelse(u < U0, hi, mid)
    }
    z1 <- (lo + hi) / 2
    w_i <- z1 + util(z1)$spend - y[idx]
    W[k] <- sum(w_i)
    if (detail) det[[k]] <- list(idx = idx, z1 = z1, w = w_i)
  }
  if (detail) list(W = W, det = det, U0 = b$U0, R = ifelse(x > 0, b$psi, 0), z0 = b$z) else W
}

# compensating numeraire such that utility at prices P equals U0 (Hicksian), by bisection on
# log t = (1 - a1) log z between lt_lo (utility below U0) and lt_hi (utility above U0).
# Returns z1 and spending on sites at z1.
md_hicks_R <- function(R, P, U0, lt_lo, lt_hi, G, a1, iters = 200) {
  b <- 1 / (1 - a1); RP <- R / P; lRP <- ifelse(RP > 0, log(RP), -Inf)
  util <- function(lt) {
    on <- RP * exp(lt) > 1
    list(U = rowSums(ifelse(on, R * G * (lRP + lt), 0)) + exp(a1 * b * lt) / a1,
         spend = rowSums(ifelse(on, P * G * (RP * exp(lt) - 1), 0)))
  }
  lo <- lt_lo; hi <- lt_hi
  for (it in 1:iters) { mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; low <- util(mid)$U < U0; lo[low] <- mid[low]; hi[!low] <- mid[!low] }
  lt <- (lo + hi) / 2
  list(z1 = exp(b * lt), spend = util(lt)$spend)
}

# Modified Latin hypercube draws (Hess et al., 2006), as in rmdcev: for each of n vectors, D
# uniform draws, one in each interval [(d-1)/D, d/D), in random order. Returns an n x D matrix.
mlhs <- function(n, D) {
  U <- (matrix(rep(0:(D - 1), each = n), n, D) + matrix(runif(n * D), n, D)) / D
  idx <- t(apply(matrix(runif(n * D), n, D), 1, order))
  matrix(U[cbind(rep(1:n, D), as.vector(idx))], n, D)
}

# Conditional error draws, following rmdcev (Lloyd-Smith, 2021): the error of the numeraire is set
# to zero, the errors of visited sites follow from the first-order conditions at the observed trips,
# and the error of each site not visited is drawn from the type I extreme value distribution
# truncated so that the site is not chosen (R_j / p_j <= lambda). This gives
# R_j / (lambda p_j) = (1 + E / w_j)^(-sigma), with E = -log(u), u a modified Latin hypercube draw,
# and w_j = (psi_j / (lambda p_j))^(1/sigma). Sites without trips in the sample are not available.
# (numeraire = "posterior" instead draws the numeraire error from its distribution given the
# observed trips; this was used in an earlier version and is kept for reference.)
# Returns the visited R (N x J) and, for every draw, the unvisited R (N x J x D).
md_cond_draws <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, lpsi, scale, D, numeraire = c("zero", "posterior")) {
  numeraire <- match.arg(numeraire)
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x); G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  vis <- x > 0; avail <- matrix(colSums(x) > 0, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); lam0 <- z0^(a1 - 1)
  R <- ifelse(vis, p * (1 + x / G) * lam0, 0)
  psi <- matrix(exp(lpsi), N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  w <- (psi / (lam0 * p))^(1 / scale)
  unv <- !vis & avail
  K <- rowSums(vis)
  Rd <- array(0, c(N, J, D))
  if (numeraire == "zero") {
    U <- array(mlhs(N * J, D), c(N, J, D))                     # draws for camper i, site j in U[i, j, ]
    for (d in 1:D) Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 - log(U[, , d]) / w)^(-scale), 0)
  } else {
    A <- 1 + rowSums(ifelse(vis, (psi / R)^(1 / scale), 0)) + rowSums(ifelse(unv, w, 0))
    for (d in 1:D) {
      t <- rgamma(N, shape = K + 1, rate = A)
      E <- matrix(rexp(N * J), N, J)
      Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 + E / (t * w))^(-scale), 0)
    }
  }
  Rd[K == 0, , ] <- 0                       # campers without trips never start a trip after a cost rise
  list(R = R, Rd = Rd, G = G, z0 = z0, lam0 = lam0,
       Mx = apply(Rd / array(p, c(N, J, D)), c(1, 3), max))       # N x D: highest R_j/p_j among unvisited
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing each site, allowing unvisited sites to enter (same logic:
# the no-entry solution is kept unless an unvisited site would be chosen at its marginal utility
# of income). Returns the losses ($, all campers), the no-entry losses and the share with entry.
md_welfare_sites_cond <- function(CD, x, p, y, g, a1) {
  J <- ncol(x); D <- dim(CD$Rd)[3]
  ne <- md_welfare_sites(x, p, y, g, a1, detail = TRUE)
  W <- ne$W; share <- rep(NA_real_, J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    d <- ne$det[[k]]; if (is.null(d)) next
    v <- d$idx; wk <- matrix(d$w, length(v), D)
    flag <- CD$Mx[v, , drop = FALSE] > d$z1^(a1 - 1)
    if (any(flag)) {
      fi <- which(flag, arr.ind = TRUE); ii <- v[fi[, 1]]
      Rf <- CD$R[ii, , drop = FALSE] + t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(fi)), function(m) CD$Rd[ii[m], , fi[m, 2]]))
      if (nrow(fi) == 1) Rf <- matrix(Rf, 1)
      Rf[, k] <- 0
      U0 <- ne$U0[ii]
      h <- md_hicks_R(Rf, p[ii, , drop = FALSE], U0, lt_lo = (1 - a1) * log(ne$z0[ii]),
                      lt_hi = (1 - a1) / a1 * log(a1 * U0), CD$G[ii, , drop = FALSE], a1)
      wk[fi] <- h$z1 + h$spend - y[ii]
    }
    W[k] <- sum(wk) / D; share[k] <- mean(flag)
  }
  list(W = W, W_ne = ne$W, share = share)
}

## ---- 3. Data in the order rmdcev uses ----------------------------------------
sd <- mdcev_mle$stan_data
x  <- sd$quant_j; p <- sd$price_j; y <- as.numeric(sd$income)
N  <- sd$I; J <- sd$J
sites <- as.character(data_model$parkname[data_model$id == data_model$id[1]])

## parameters from one row of draws (or the point estimates): site 1 is the base (psi = 0)
get_pars <- function(th) {
  nm <- names(th)
  list(lpsi  = c(0, th[grepl("^psi\\[", nm)]),
       g     = th[grepl("^gamma\\[", nm)],
       a1    = th[grepl("^alpha\\[", nm)][1],
       scale = th[grepl("^scale\\[", nm)][1])
}

## welfare (per person) and total-trip elasticities for one parameter set
md_measures <- function(pr, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)                                                    # MLHS draws for unvisited sites
  CD <- md_cond_draws(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, pr$lpsi, pr$scale, NERRS)
  W  <- c(md_welfare_sites_cond(CD, x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)$W,
          md_welfare_all(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)) / N
  el <- sapply(s_vec, function(s) md_elast(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, s))
  c(-W, el)                                                         # losses negative, as rmdcev
}

               "alpha[1,1]", "scale[1]")

## ---- 2. Functions -------------------------------------------------------------
# conditional demand after travel costs are multiplied by Fm (N x J matrix of factors),
# with income fixed and the marginal utility of income adjusting. For each camper, the new
# numeraire z solves  y - sum_j Fm_j p_j x_j(z) - z = 0, where
# x_j(z) = g_j [ (1 + x_j/g_j) / Fm_j (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1 ]  for visited sites (0 if negative).
# The left side falls in z, is positive at z = 0 and non-positive at z = y, so the root is
# bracketed and found by bisection; the budget residual is checked.
md_solve <- function(x, p, y, G, a1, Fm, iters = 200, return_z = FALSE) {
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); stopifnot(all(z0 > 0))
  r <- 1 + x / G; vis <- x > 0
  dem <- function(z) ifelse(vis, pmax(0, G * (r / Fm * (z / z0)^(1 - a1) - 1)), 0)
  excess <- function(z) y - rowSums(Fm * p * dem(z)) - z
  lo <- rep(0, length(y)); hi <- y
  for (it in 1:iters) {
    mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; pos <- excess(mid) > 0
    lo[pos] <- mid[pos]; hi[!pos] <- mid[!pos]
  }
  zs <- (lo + hi) / 2
  if (max(abs(excess(zs))) > 1e-6) stop("md_solve: budget residual too large")
  if (return_z) list(x = dem(zs), z = zs) else dem(zs)
}


# elasticity of total trips when all travel costs rise by s (lambda adjusts)
md_elast <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, s) {
  v <- which(rowSums(x) > 0)
  G <- matrix(g, length(v), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  xn <- md_solve(x[v, , drop = FALSE], p[v, , drop = FALSE], y[v], G, a1,
                 matrix(1 + s, length(v), ncol(x)))
  (sum(xn) / sum(x) - 1) / s
}

# baseline utility (numeraire weight normalised to 1)
md_U0 <- function(x, p, y, G, a1) {
  z <- y - rowSums(p * x)
  psi <- p * (1 + x / G) * z^(a1 - 1)
  list(U0 = rowSums(ifelse(x > 0, psi * G * log1p(x / G), 0)) + z^a1 / a1, psi = psi, z = z)
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing all sites (closed form)
md_welfare_all <- function(x, p, y, g, a1) {
  G <- matrix(g, nrow(x), ncol(x), byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  sum((a1 * b$U0)^(1 / a1) - y)
}

# conditional (Hicksian) welfare loss of closing each site one at a time, holding sites not
# visited at baseline at zero trips (this can only raise the loss). For each camper who visited site k: find the numeraire z1 at which utility without
# site k (other visited sites re-optimised) equals baseline utility; the loss is the
# extra spending needed, z1 + sum p_j x_j(z1) - y.
md_welfare_sites <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, iters = 200, detail = FALSE) {
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x)
  G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  b <- md_U0(x, p, y, G, a1)
  W <- numeric(J); det <- vector("list", J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    idx <- which(x[, k] > 0)
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    xs <- x[idx, , drop = FALSE]; ps <- p[idx, , drop = FALSE]; Gs <- G[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    psi <- b$psi[idx, , drop = FALSE]; U0 <- b$U0[idx]
    keep <- (xs > 0); keep[, k] <- FALSE                     # other visited sites
    util <- function(z) {                                     # utility at numeraire z (vector)
      lam <- z^(a1 - 1)
      ratio <- psi / (lam * ps)                               # = 1 + x/G at the optimum
      xj <- ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, Gs * (ratio - 1), 0)
      list(U = rowSums(ifelse(keep & ratio > 1, psi * Gs * log(ratio), 0)) + z^a1 / a1,
           spend = rowSums(ps * xj))
    }
    lo <- b$z[idx]                                            # utility too low here
    hi <- (a1 * U0)^(1 / a1)                                  # numeraire alone reaches U0
    for (it in 1:iters) {
      mid <- (lo + hi) / 2
      u <- util(mid)$U
      lo <- ifelse(u < U0, mid, lo); hi <- ifelse(u < U0, hi, mid)
    }
    z1 <- (lo + hi) / 2
    w_i <- z1 + util(z1)$spend - y[idx]
    W[k] <- sum(w_i)
    if (detail) det[[k]] <- list(idx = idx, z1 = z1, w = w_i)
  }
  if (detail) list(W = W, det = det, U0 = b$U0, R = ifelse(x > 0, b$psi, 0), z0 = b$z) else W
}

# compensating numeraire such that utility at prices P equals U0 (Hicksian), by bisection on
# log t = (1 - a1) log z between lt_lo (utility below U0) and lt_hi (utility above U0).
# Returns z1 and spending on sites at z1.
md_hicks_R <- function(R, P, U0, lt_lo, lt_hi, G, a1, iters = 200) {
  b <- 1 / (1 - a1); RP <- R / P; lRP <- ifelse(RP > 0, log(RP), -Inf)
  util <- function(lt) {
    on <- RP * exp(lt) > 1
    list(U = rowSums(ifelse(on, R * G * (lRP + lt), 0)) + exp(a1 * b * lt) / a1,
         spend = rowSums(ifelse(on, P * G * (RP * exp(lt) - 1), 0)))
  }
  lo <- lt_lo; hi <- lt_hi
  for (it in 1:iters) { mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; low <- util(mid)$U < U0; lo[low] <- mid[low]; hi[!low] <- mid[!low] }
  lt <- (lo + hi) / 2
  list(z1 = exp(b * lt), spend = util(lt)$spend)
}

# Modified Latin hypercube draws (Hess et al., 2006), as in rmdcev: for each of n vectors, D
# uniform draws, one in each interval [(d-1)/D, d/D), in random order. Returns an n x D matrix.
mlhs <- function(n, D) {
  U <- (matrix(rep(0:(D - 1), each = n), n, D) + matrix(runif(n * D), n, D)) / D
  idx <- t(apply(matrix(runif(n * D), n, D), 1, order))
  matrix(U[cbind(rep(1:n, D), as.vector(idx))], n, D)
}

# Conditional error draws, following rmdcev (Lloyd-Smith, 2021): the error of the numeraire is set
# to zero, the errors of visited sites follow from the first-order conditions at the observed trips,
# and the error of each site not visited is drawn from the type I extreme value distribution
# truncated so that the site is not chosen (R_j / p_j <= lambda). This gives
# R_j / (lambda p_j) = (1 + E / w_j)^(-sigma), with E = -log(u), u a modified Latin hypercube draw,
# and w_j = (psi_j / (lambda p_j))^(1/sigma). Sites without trips in the sample are not available.
# (numeraire = "posterior" instead draws the numeraire error from its distribution given the
# observed trips; this was used in an earlier version and is kept for reference.)
# Returns the visited R (N x J) and, for every draw, the unvisited R (N x J x D).
md_cond_draws <- function(x, p, y, g, a1, lpsi, scale, D, numeraire = c("zero", "posterior")) {
  numeraire <- match.arg(numeraire)
  N <- nrow(x); J <- ncol(x); G <- matrix(g, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  vis <- x > 0; avail <- matrix(colSums(x) > 0, N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  z0 <- y - rowSums(p * x); lam0 <- z0^(a1 - 1)
  R <- ifelse(vis, p * (1 + x / G) * lam0, 0)
  psi <- matrix(exp(lpsi), N, J, byrow = TRUE)
  w <- (psi / (lam0 * p))^(1 / scale)
  unv <- !vis & avail
  K <- rowSums(vis)
  Rd <- array(0, c(N, J, D))
  if (numeraire == "zero") {
    U <- array(mlhs(N * J, D), c(N, J, D))                     # draws for camper i, site j in U[i, j, ]
    for (d in 1:D) Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 - log(U[, , d]) / w)^(-scale), 0)
  } else {
    A <- 1 + rowSums(ifelse(vis, (psi / R)^(1 / scale), 0)) + rowSums(ifelse(unv, w, 0))
    for (d in 1:D) {
      t <- rgamma(N, shape = K + 1, rate = A)
      E <- matrix(rexp(N * J), N, J)
      Rd[, , d] <- ifelse(unv, lam0 * p * (1 + E / (t * w))^(-scale), 0)
    }
  }
  Rd[K == 0, , ] <- 0                       # campers without trips never start a trip after a cost rise
  list(R = R, Rd = Rd, G = G, z0 = z0, lam0 = lam0,
       Mx = apply(Rd / array(p, c(N, J, D)), c(1, 3), max))       # N x D: highest R_j/p_j among unvisited
}

# conditional welfare loss of closing each site, allowing unvisited sites to enter (same logic:
# the no-entry solution is kept unless an unvisited site would be chosen at its marginal utility
# of income). Returns the losses ($, all campers), the no-entry losses and the share with entry.
md_welfare_sites_cond <- function(CD, x, p, y, g, a1) {
  J <- ncol(x); D <- dim(CD$Rd)[3]
  ne <- md_welfare_sites(x, p, y, g, a1, detail = TRUE)
  W <- ne$W; share <- rep(NA_real_, J)
  for (k in 1:J) {
    d <- ne$det[[k]]; if (is.null(d)) next
    v <- d$idx; wk <- matrix(d$w, length(v), D)
    flag <- CD$Mx[v, , drop = FALSE] > d$z1^(a1 - 1)
    if (any(flag)) {
      fi <- which(flag, arr.ind = TRUE); ii <- v[fi[, 1]]
      Rf <- CD$R[ii, , drop = FALSE] + t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(fi)), function(m) CD$Rd[ii[m], , fi[m, 2]]))
      if (nrow(fi) == 1) Rf <- matrix(Rf, 1)
      Rf[, k] <- 0
      U0 <- ne$U0[ii]
      h <- md_hicks_R(Rf, p[ii, , drop = FALSE], U0, lt_lo = (1 - a1) * log(ne$z0[ii]),
                      lt_hi = (1 - a1) / a1 * log(a1 * U0), CD$G[ii, , drop = FALSE], a1)
      wk[fi] <- h$z1 + h$spend - y[ii]
    }
    W[k] <- sum(wk) / D; share[k] <- mean(flag)
  }
  list(W = W, W_ne = ne$W, share = share)
}

## ---- 3. Data in the order rmdcev uses ----------------------------------------

N  <- sd$I; J <- sd$J

## parameters from one row of draws (or the point estimates): site 1 is the base (psi = 0)
get_pars <- function(th) {
  nm <- names(th)
  list(lpsi  = c(0, th[grepl("^psi\\[", nm)]),
       g     = th[grepl("^gamma\\[", nm)],
       a1    = th[grepl("^alpha\\[", nm)][1],
       scale = th[grepl("^scale\\[", nm)][1])
}

## welfare (per person) and total-trip elasticities for one parameter set
md_measures <- function(pr, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)                                                    # MLHS draws for unvisited sites
  CD <- md_cond_draws(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, pr$lpsi, pr$scale, NERRS)
  W  <- c(md_welfare_sites_cond(CD, x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)$W,
          md_welfare_all(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1)) / N
  el <- sapply(s_vec, function(s) md_elast(x, p, y, pr$g, pr$a1, s))
  c(-W, el)                                                         # losses negative, as rmdcev
}

s_vec <- c(0.01, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50)

pred_total <- function(b, s) {
  prob <- function(Xm) {
    V <- matrix(Xm %*% b, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P / rowSums(P)
  }
  Xn <- X1; Xn[, "price"] <- (1 + s) * X1[, "price"]   # Stay_Home price stays 0
  base <- 52 * sum(prob(X1)[, site_cols])
  new  <- 52 * sum(prob(Xn)[, site_cols])
  100 * (new / base - 1)                                 # % change in total trips
}

X    <- model.matrix(m)
oid  <- as.character(idx(dl, 1)); alt <- as.character(idx(dl, 2))
alts <- alt[1:length(unique(alt))]; K <- length(alts)
stopifnot(all(alt == rep(alts, length(unique(oid)))))
first <- grepl("_w1$", oid)
X1    <- X[first, , drop = FALSE]
pid   <- sub("_w1$", "", oid[first][seq(1, sum(first), by = K)])
site_cols <- match(sites, alts); home_col <- match("Stay_Home", alts)

N <- d %>% dplyr::select(id, parkname, VisitCount) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parkname, values_from = VisitCount, values_fill = 0)
N <- as.matrix(N[match(pid, N$id), sites])                 # observed trips, campers x sites

probs <- function(b) {                                     # choice probabilities, campers x alternatives
  V <- matrix(X1 %*% b, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
  P <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P / rowSums(P)
}

summ_kr <- function(point, kr) {                           # mean + 95% Krinsky-Robb bounds
  data.frame(mean  = point,
             lower = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.025),
             upper = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.975))
}

## Krinsky-Robb draws (same draws for both measures)
set.seed(898989 + 2021)
draws <- mvrnorm(1000, coef(m), vcov(m))

###############################################################
## 4a. UNCONDITIONAL welfare (log-sum x 52), mean per camper ##
###############################################################
welfare_unc <- function(b) {
  P  <- probs(b); bp <- -b[["price"]]
  Pj <- P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]; P0 <- P[, home_col]
  site <- 52 * log(1 - Pj) / bp
  c(setNames(colMeans(site), sites),
    "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
    "All sites closed"          = mean(52 * log(P0) / bp),
    "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site)))
}
kr_unc <- t(apply(draws, 1, welfare_unc))
unc    <- summ_kr(welfare_unc(coef(m)), kr_unc)

welfare_con <- function(b) {
  P  <- probs(b); bp <- -b[["price"]]
  Pj <- P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]; P0 <- P[, home_col]; n <- rowSums(N)
  site <- N * log(1 - Pj) / (Pj * bp)
  c(setNames(colMeans(site), sites),
    "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
    "All sites closed"          = mean(n * log(P0) / ((1 - P0) * bp)),
    "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site)))
}

## 4c. UNCONDITIONAL welfare PER VISITOR: mean over the campers who visited each site
############################################
vis <- N > 0                                               # campers x sites: visited the site
nv  <- colSums(vis)                                        # number of visitors of each site

welfare_unc_vis <- function(b) {
  P  <- probs(b); bp <- -b[["price"]]
  Pj <- P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]; P0 <- P[, home_col]
  site <- 52 * log(1 - Pj) / bp                            # as in 4a
  part <- rowSums(vis) > 0                                 # campers who visited at least one site
  w <- colSums(site * vis) / nv                            # mean over the campers who visited the site
  c(setNames(w, sites),
    "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site * vis)[part]),  # each camper's losses at the sites they visited
    "All sites closed"          = mean(52 * log(P0[part]) / bp),
    "Average site closure"      = mean(w))
}

############################################
## 5. Demand simulations: % change in total trips and elasticity
############################################
s_vec <- c(0.01, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50)

pred_total <- function(b, s) {
  prob <- function(Xm) {
    V <- matrix(Xm %*% b, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P / rowSums(P)
  }
  Xn <- X1; Xn[, "price"] <- (1 + s) * X1[, "price"]   # Stay_Home price stays 0
  base <- 52 * sum(prob(X1)[, site_cols])
  new  <- 52 * sum(prob(Xn)[, site_cols])
  100 * (new / base - 1)                                 # % change in total trips
}

draws <- mvrnorm(1000, coef(m), vcov(m))                 # Krinsky–Robb

pct_pt <- sapply(s_vec, function(s) pred_total(coef(m), s))
pct_kr <- sapply(s_vec, function(s) apply(draws, 1, pred_total, s = s))   # 1000 x 4
el_kr  <- sweep(pct_kr, 2, 100 * s_vec, "/")

out <- rbind(pct_change = pct_pt,
             pct_2.5    = apply(pct_kr, 2, quantile, .025),
             pct_97.5   = apply(pct_kr, 2, quantile, .975),
             elasticity = pct_pt / (100 * s_vec),
             el_2.5     = apply(el_kr, 2, quantile, .025),
             el_97.5    = apply(el_kr, 2, quantile, .975))
colnames(out) <- paste0("+", 100 * s_vec, "%")

s_vec <- c(0.01, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50)

pred_total <- function(b, s) {
  prob <- function(Xm) {
    V <- matrix(Xm %*% b, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P / rowSums(P)
  }
  Xn <- X1; Xn[, "price"] <- (1 + s) * X1[, "price"]   # Stay_Home price stays 0
  base <- 52 * sum(prob(X1)[, site_cols])
  new  <- 52 * sum(prob(Xn)[, site_cols])
  100 * (new / base - 1)                                 # % change in total trips
}

  Pj <- P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]; P0 <- P[, home_col]; n <- rowSums(N)
  site <- N * log(1 - Pj) / (Pj * bp)
  c(setNames(colMeans(site), sites),
    "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
    "All sites closed"          = mean(n * log(P0) / ((1 - P0) * bp)),
    "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site)))
}

pred_total <- function(b, s) {

    V <- matrix(Xm %*% b, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P / rowSums(P)
  }
  Xn <- X1; Xn[, "price"] <- (1 + s) * X1[, "price"]   # Stay_Home price stays 0
  base <- 52 * sum(prob(X1)[, site_cols])
  new  <- 52 * sum(prob(Xn)[, site_cols])
  100 * (new / base - 1)                                 # % change in total trips
}

Comparision
This runs the fast and the Original and compares the two. Note that

suppressMessages({ library(mlogit); library(dfidx) })

## ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_mlogit <- function(obj) {                       # first mlogit object inside obj
    if (inherits(obj, "mlogit")) return(obj)
    if (is.list(obj) && !is.data.frame(obj))
        for (el in obj) { f <- find_mlogit(el); if (!is.null(f)) return(f) }
    NULL
}

## unconditional welfare (point estimate) straight from an mlogit model.
## Every camper has the same 52 occasions, so the mean over occasions = the mean per camper.
## The reference ("stay home") alternative is the one without an intercept, and the price
## coefficient is the one coefficient that is not an intercept, so names need not match.
rum_unc <- function(mod) {
    b  <- coef(mod); X <- model.matrix(mod)
    ix <- tryCatch(list(idx(mod, 1), idx(mod, 2)),
                   error = function(e) list(idx(mod$model, 1), idx(mod$model, 2)))
    oid <- as.character(ix[[1]]); alt <- as.character(ix[[2]])
    alts <- unique(alt); K <- length(alts); nocc <- length(unique(oid))
    stopifnot(length(alt) == K * nocc, all(alt == rep(alts, nocc)))
    
    int_alts <- sub("^\\(Intercept\\):", "", grep("^\\(Intercept\\):", names(b), value = TRUE))
    home     <- setdiff(alts, int_alts); stopifnot(length(home) == 1)
    pname    <- setdiff(names(b), grep("^\\(Intercept\\):", names(b), value = TRUE))
    stopifnot(length(pname) == 1)                      # travel cost only
    sites    <- sort(setdiff(alts, home))
    
    V  <- matrix(X %*% b[colnames(X)], ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P  <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P <- P / rowSums(P)
    bp <- -b[[pname]]
    site <- 52 * log(1 - P[, match(sites, alts), drop = FALSE]) / bp
    list(welfare = c(setNames(colMeans(site), sites),
                     "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
                     "All sites closed"          = mean(52 * log(P[, match(home, alts)]) / bp),
                     "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site))),
         info = c(occasions = nocc, campers = nocc / 52, alternatives = K,
                  logLik = as.numeric(logLik(mod)), price = b[[pname]]),
         home = home, price_name = pname)
}

## ---- comparison for one year ------------------------------------------------------------------
compare_rum_year <- function(YEAR) {
    yr  <- as.character(YEAR)
    new_m   <- get(paste0("m_", yr))
    new_unc <- get(paste0("unc_", yr))
    old_m   <- find_mlogit(model_list_52[[paste0("52wk ", yr)]])
    if (is.null(old_m)) stop("no mlogit model found in model_list_52$`52wk ", yr, "`")
    
    new_r <- rum_unc(new_m); old_r <- rum_unc(old_m)
    
    ## self-check: the helper reproduces the script's own unconditional welfare
    chk <- max(abs(new_r$welfare - new_unc[names(new_r$welfare), "mean"]))
    cat("\n=====", yr, "=====\nself-check (helper vs unc_", yr, "): max |diff| = ",
        signif(chk, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    
    ## model information
    info <- rbind(new = new_r$info, old = old_r$info)
    print(round(info, 4))
    if (new_r$home != old_r$home || new_r$price_name != old_r$price_name)
        cat("note: reference / price names differ (new:", new_r$home, new_r$price_name,
            " old:", old_r$home, old_r$price_name, ")\n")
    
    ## coefficients, matched by name
    bn <- coef(new_m); bo <- coef(old_m)
    cn <- union(names(bn), names(bo))
    coefs <- data.frame(coef = cn, new = unname(bn[cn]), old = unname(bo[cn]))
    coefs$diff <- coefs$new - coefs$old
    cat("coefficients: max |diff| =", signif(max(abs(coefs$diff), na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        "; only in one model:", sum(is.na(coefs$diff)), "\n")
    
    ## unconditional welfare, matched by measure name
    mn <- union(names(new_r$welfare), names(old_r$welfare))
    wel <- data.frame(year = YEAR, measure = mn,
                      new = unname(new_r$welfare[mn]), old = unname(old_r$welfare[mn]))
    wel$diff     <- wel$new - wel$old
    wel$pct_diff <- 100 * wel$diff / abs(wel$old)
    print(wel[, -1], digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
    
    overview <- data.frame(
        year              = YEAR,
        same_campers      = info["new", "campers"] == info["old", "campers"],
        same_alternatives = info["new", "alternatives"] == info["old", "alternatives"],
        logLik_new        = info["new", "logLik"],
        logLik_old        = info["old", "logLik"],
        max_abs_coef_diff = max(abs(coefs$diff), na.rm = TRUE),
        coefs_unmatched   = sum(is.na(coefs$diff)),
        all_closed_new    = new_r$welfare[["All sites closed"]],
        all_closed_old    = old_r$welfare[["All sites closed"]],
        max_abs_pct_welf  = max(abs(wel$pct_diff), na.rm = TRUE),
        measures_unmatched = sum(is.na(wel$diff))
    )
    invisible(list(coefs = coefs, welfare = wel, overview = overview))
}
